sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Line limit and document check script
sections.what: Counts the lines in the agent instruction file and stops with an error if it is longer than 120. Then it checks that each listed project document exists and stops at the first one missing.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the agent file brief and its linked documents present. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The script stops at the first missing document, so only one problem is reported per run.

summary: Checks that the agent instruction file stays at or under 120 lines and that the listed project documents exist.
purpose: Keeps the agent instruction file short and makes sure its linked documents are present.
why: Likely reason: a short instruction file is easier for agents to follow, and missing links would confuse them. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Counts the lines in the agent file, fails with a message if the count is over 120, then checks each listed document exists and fails on the first missing one.
inputs: The AGENTS.md file and the list of document paths in the script, read from the current folder.
outputs: Silent success, or an error message on the error output with a failing exit code.
risks: Must be run from the folder that holds AGENTS.md, or it will report the file as missing. The 120 limit and the document list are fixed in the script.
debug: If it fails with missing file, run it from the folder containing AGENTS.md. If the list is out of date, update the document paths in the script.
